security_audit.summary: All static findings are false positives caused by Markdown backticks, documentation links, and a fixed relative reference to shared skill guidance. No prompt injection, malicious exfiltration intent, or unauthorized runtime code path was found in SKILL.md.

remediation.suggestion: Keep examples, but label them as user-run CLI examples and avoid language that implies automatic execution.

remediation.issue: The skill can perform sensitive Google Meet administration when used with authorized credentials.
remediation.suggestion: Require explicit user confirmation before ending conferences, patching spaces, or accessing meeting artifacts.

content.value_statement: Google Meet administration often requires precise conference and space commands. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through gws Meet operations.
actual_capabilities: Shows the gws meet command structure for resources, methods, and flags.
Guides users to inspect required parameters with gws schema before making calls.
Documents conference record operations, including get and list.
Identifies participant, recording, smart note, and transcript resources under conference records.
Documents meeting space operations, including create, get, patch, and end active conference.
limitations: Requires the gws CLI to be installed and available in the environment.
Requires authenticated Google Workspace credentials with the needed Meet permissions.
Does not create OAuth clients, grant admin roles, or bypass Workspace policies.
Does not include full parameter examples for every Meet API method.

use_cases.title: Review conference records
use_cases.description: Find and inspect Google Meet conference records for operational review.

use_cases.title: Support meeting spaces
use_cases.description: Check meeting space details and prepare safe updates with the correct parameters.

use_cases.title: Locate meeting artifacts
use_cases.description: Navigate participant, recording, smart note, and transcript resources for authorized review.

prompt_templates.title: List available Meet commands
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the Google Meet skill to show which gws meet resources and methods are available. Do not make changes.

prompt_templates.title: Inspect a Meet method
prompt_templates.prompt: Inspect the schema for the Google Meet method I name, then summarize required parameters and safe optional flags.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare a meeting space update
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me prepare a gws Meet space patch. Show the planned fields first and ask for confirmation before any update.

prompt_templates.title: Audit meeting artifacts
prompt_templates.prompt: Plan a read-only workflow to find conference records, participants, recordings, smart notes, and transcripts for a specific meeting.

output_examples.input: Show me how to inspect the parameters for a Meet space update.
output_examples.output: The assistant identifies the relevant gws schema command, explains required fields, and asks which space should be reviewed.

output_examples.input: Find the resources related to a completed meeting.
output_examples.output: The assistant outlines a read-only sequence for conference records, participants, recordings, smart notes, and transcripts.

output_examples.input: End an active conference for this space.
output_examples.output: The assistant states the impact, checks the target space, and requests explicit confirmation before proceeding.

best_practices: Inspect each method schema before building parameters or JSON flags.
Use read-only commands first when investigating meeting records or artifacts.
Confirm the target meeting space before any patch or end active conference action.
anti_patterns: Do not run destructive Meet actions without a clear user confirmation.
Do not request transcripts, recordings, or participant data without authorization.
Do not assume parameter names or defaults without checking the schema output.

faq.question: What does this skill manage?
faq.answer: It helps use the gws CLI for Google Meet conference records and meeting spaces.

faq.question: Does it need Google Workspace access?
faq.answer: Yes. It requires authenticated gws credentials with permissions for the requested Meet operation.

faq.question: Can it end an active meeting?
faq.answer: It documents that operation. Users should require confirmation before ending any active conference.

faq.question: Can it read recordings or transcripts?
faq.answer: It can guide access to those resources when the authenticated account has permission.

faq.question: Does it run automatically?
faq.answer: No. The skill provides command guidance for user-directed gws CLI operations.

faq.question: Which assistants can use it?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
